rationale.edition: All eight changed paths live under web/src/plugins/traces/ (LLMContentRenderer.vue, TraceDetailsSidebar.vue, genAiParts.ts, threadView.utils.ts plus their *.spec.ts unit tests). None sit under enterprise-owned directories (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/), and no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/logo-management) appear in the paths or symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: No skip. The trigger comment and feature hint are empty (no tests-added label and no skip request), and the diff is not docs/CI/comment-only — it changes three user-facing traces surfaces (LLM preview pane, span sidebar system instructions, thread view), so the no-user-facing-change gate does not apply.
rationale.e2e: Warranted. The change teaches the LLM trace preview (LLMContentRenderer), the span sidebar system-instructions parser (TraceDetailsSidebar), and the thread view (threadView.utils) to render OTel GenAI semconv v5 `parts` messages (reasoning, tool_call, tool_call_response, thinking/result aliases, blob/file/uri placeholders) as text instead of blank turns or raw JSON dumps. A user viewing an LLM trace with these parts sees different content, so E2E should verify the rendered output.
rationale.area: Traces. Every changed file is under web/src/plugins/traces/, and the sibling Playwright specs live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Traces/ (traceDetails.spec.js, traceErrorFilter.spec.js, traceQueryEditor.spec.js, tracesSearch.spec.js, etc.), so the Traces area is the correct home.
rationale.group: Traces is the closest existing matrix shard. The ci-matrix overlay appends trace specs (e.g. service-graph.spec.js) to the Traces testfolder group, and there is no more specific LLM/GenAI trace shard, so the new spec belongs in the Traces group.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The four changed *.spec.ts files (LLMContentRenderer.spec.ts, TraceDetailsSidebar.spec.ts, genAiParts.spec.ts, threadView.utils.spec.ts) are Vitest unit tests under web/src/, not Playwright specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so they do not count as E2E coverage of the new feature.
